svg.title: 02 · Login & customer mapping
svg.desc: The user signs in at Microsoft Entra ID; Amazon Cognito federates the sign-in, maps the user's assigned group to exactly one customer and issues the ID token that gate 4 checks on every request.
svg.text: Sign-in order: user → Entra ID → Cognito → token. The token is the only place the customer comes from.
